title: Client rule vectors
description: One file per rule, each holding the vectors an implementation of that rule must reproduce: a client's for the client rules, DFO's for the analysis and publication rules. rules/README.md states each rule.

one_line.description: Text without a newline. Python's `re.search` lets an anchored pattern's `$` match before a final newline, so every pattern here anchored with `$` refers to this as well.

env.description: The environment variables set for the vector. A variable not listed is unset.

api_key.description: The api_key argument: a key string, the empty string a client refuses, or false to force anonymous use. Absent when the caller passes none.

file.description: The text of the credentials file at the credentials path, or null when no file exists there.

base_url.description: The base URL argument of the call or constructor, which may be the empty string a client refuses. Absent when the caller passes none.

pattern.description: A regular expression every well-formed header value matches in full.

version.description: The package version as the package states it.

runtime.description: The runtime's name and its full version, or `browser` with no version.

value.description: The X-DFO-Client value the client sends.

via.description: Where the caller's headers come from: the client's headers argument, or the header provider it calls before each request.

headers.description: The caller's headers, by name as the caller writes it.

reading_columns.description: The reading slots in order. Each slot lists the column names that fill it, each long layout's label before its frame layout's code; the first name a dataset holds fills the slot.

members.description: The members a dataset stacks, in member order, each its served table: its `part` value when the dataset has several members, its columns and its rows in the order the server wrote them.

columns.description: The columns a client presents, in its order.

rows.description: The rows a client presents, in its order, each in the presented column order.

keys.description: Each key a caller types in entities=, to the wire role it posts as.

flow_keys.description: The flow directions. A spec that names one takes both.

identity.description: The spec's definition.identity members that name roles, by wire role.

roles.description: The caller keys the spec takes, in order, each to the dcids it binds or null: Spec.roles in Python, specRoles(spec) in TypeScript.

entities.description: The caller's entities=, each key to dcids or to null, which drops the role.

posted.description: The build's scope.entities, by wire role.

names.description: The keys the message names: the key typed, then the spec's caller keys, or place for observationAbout on a spec that names no role.

columns.description: The frame's columns in the frame grammar's order.

frame.description: A frame as docs/frame-grammar-v1.md defines it, each row in its column order.

variables.description: The name of each variable an operation of the frame's recipe wrote, keyed by the operation's ops_ id, which the frame's stat_var cells spell after dcid:.

document.description: The output digest document, as the UTF-8 text the digest hashes.

equal.description: Whether the refs name the same versions, recipes and renderings: `==` in Python, `equals` in TypeScript.

same_data.description: Whether the refs hold the same output: `same_data` in Python, `sameData` in TypeScript.

on.description: Each role of data, to the role of other it pairs with.

data.description: The rows of the first reading, each its frame row by column name.

other.description: The rows of the second reading, for an operation that takes one.

rows.description: The output rows, in any order. A row leaves out stat_var when the operation writes a variable of its own.

error.description: The code the operation refuses with in place of rows.

series.description: Every series of the roots, by its root's spec_id and coordinates, with the periods it holds a row at.

steps.description: The rolling steps of one recipe tree, each with the populations it counts the latest period over.

tokenless.description: The share holds no write token, as a guest's share migrates.

write_token.description: `held` for the token the share's creation returned, `other` for another; absent sends none.
`held` for the token the share's creation returned, `other` for another; absent sends none.

members.description: The left-out series of each derived member one fetch returns, in member order, as its derived manifest serves them.

left_out.description: Every series a step of the recipe dropped for a data gap; null for a recipe stored without them.

left_out_complete.description: False when the steps dropped more series than `left_out` lists; null with a null `left_out`.

warnings.description: The warnings the fetch issues, each once.

raises.description: The warning a strict fetch raises in place of its data.
